digest.component_or_area: rebar search command and identifier resolution
propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by their canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key, only by title/description/tags/comments content
a user can successfully resolve a ticket via 'rebar show REB-1654' but 'rebar search REB-1654' returns empty results, creating the false impression the ticket does not exist
_haystack builds searchable text excluding all ticket identifiers (ticket_id, alias, jira_key), and the reduced state carries no Jira key at all
identifier matching must be case-insensitive so queries like 'REB-1654' (uppercase) and 'reb-1654' (lowercase) both surface the bound ticket
search_states must remain pure (no filesystem/binding-store access); Jira key enrichment must occur in the caller search_state by building a ticket_id->jira_key map once from the binding store
